selection_note: Chosen because a PUCT docket receipt, ERCOT market notice and board action give an unusually well-timestamped chain. Hindsight-selected development case after the outcome was known; not a sealed holdout; not independently cited.

signals.source_quote:
Collectively, all three units produce 859 megawatts of power, according to [a presentation given by CPS leaders at an ERCOT meeting in Austin on Tuesday.](https://www.ercot.com/files/docs/2024/08/16/5-1-update-on-cps-energy-reliability-must-run-rmr-and-must-run-alternative-mra-process.pdf)

While CPS Energy wants to shut the plants down, ERCOT argues that the units are vital to the state’s power grid.

target.title: ERCOT market notice M-D122024-01 (Dec 20, 2024): RFP for Must-Run Alternatives to the Life Cycle Power mobile generation solution (15 CenterPoint-leased units) and Braunig Units 1 & 2

availability_evidence.note: Only proof is text printed in the capture: the distribution-email header 'Sent:12/20/24, 4:24 PM' (Central time, CST = UTC-6) and 'NOTICE DATE: December 20, 2024'. An email 'Sent' stamp is not an exchange/docket/Wayback proof type, and the earliest Wayback snapshot of the notice URL is only 2025-07-25 (later). The agent also saw an HTTP Last-Modified of Fri, 20 Dec 2024 21:19:00 GMT on the companion RFP PDF (capture ercotmobile2025-ercot-moa); that header is not quoted in a capture and is not an accepted proof type.

target.source_quote:
ERCOT has begun discussions with CenterPoint Energy Houston Electric, LLC (CenterPoint), CPS Energy, and Prime Power Solutions, LLC, dba Life Cycle Power (Life Cycle), to explore the idea of temporarily using 15 mobile generators that CenterPoint is currently leasing from Life Cycle as an alternative to committing Braunig Units 1 and 2 through an RMR agreement.  This potential solution is still being developed, but in the interest of time, ERCOT has issued a Request for Proposal (RFP) seeking one or more MRAs that may be more cost-effective than contracting for the use of the Life Cycle mobile generators or committing Units 1 and 2 through an RMR Agreement.  The RFP can be found on [ERCOT’s website](https://www.ercot.com/about/procurement/rfp).

The characteristics and operating parameters of the Life Cycle generators, as well as desired characteristics and operating parameters of MRA proposals, can be found in the RFP. Deadlines, including those for submitting a mandatory Statement of Intent (January 10, 2025) and for submitting a proposal (January 15, 2025)
target.target_description: ERCOT market notice of Dec 20, 2024 announcing an RFP for Must-Run Alternatives, issued while ERCOT explores temporarily using 15 mobile generators CenterPoint leases from Life Cycle Power instead of an RMR agreement for Braunig Units 1 and 2.
